conditional_prior.observer: recorded Spinnaker/Sausalito site; arbitrary t=0 sidereal angle in spherical model
conditional_prior.holder_pose: illustrative only: midpoint axis local up; baseline local east
conditional_prior.elevation: uniform solid angle over 20..90 deg (sin(elevation) uniform)
